title: CLAUDE.md boosts Claude Code reliability by enforcing clear #claudecode #githubrepo #aiagent
description: CLAUDE.md improved Claude Code’s reliability by addressing common user errors like over-engineering, ignoring instructions, and inventing nonexistent APIs. This single instruction file acts as a project-level context guide, helping Claude Code consistently apply practical coding-agent rules across tasks. Integrating CLAUDE.md streamlines workflows and reduces mistakes, enhancing the overall coding experience.
